due_when.clears_when: THE RULE MUST BE CARRIED BY SOMETHING A MANAGER MEETS BEFORE IT DISPATCHES, not by another memo. Clears when BOTH: (a) the spawn-vs-resume test is written into CLAUDE.md's manager section AND docs/claude/work/README.md -- REUSE only when the next unit's inputs live in that session's context AND are not readable from the repo or a named branch; otherwise SPAWN FRESH -- with the measured basis above beside it so it cannot be read as a preference; and (b) a manager is OBSERVED choosing fresh on a unit it would previously have resumed, and saying WHICH limb of the test decided it. [!] (a) ALONE DOES NOT CLEAR IT. This repo's own record is that a reminder is not a mechanism -- the manager-scope rule needed a CI check after a fourth restatement failed. If (b) does not follow, the honest next step is a CHECK (e.g. requiring a resume to record its stated context-dependency, so a resume with none is visible), not a fifth paragraph. [!] DO NOT CLEAR THIS BY BANNING RESUME. Resume is CORRECT when the context is genuinely unrepeatable -- an investigation mid-flight, a measurement whose intermediate state was never landed -- and a blanket ban would force lanes to rebuild state the repo does not hold, which is the opposite waste. [!] AND A QUIET MONTH IS NOT EVIDENCE: the cost is silent by construction, so 'nobody complained' cannot distinguish the rule being followed from the rule being unknown. Read the cache_read delta on a resumed lane before reading any quiet as a pass.
